description:
The Saipibeci scheme is designed to provide financial assistance to the families of deceased workers in the unorganized sector. 

The objective of the scheme is to ensure social security for the families left behind after the loss of the primary breadwinner. 

The benefits include a one-time financial assistance amount to support the family during a difficult time. 

Eligibility criteria typically include being a family member of a deceased worker in the unorganized sector. 

The application process generally involves submitting a form along with necessary documents such as proof of death and identification of the applicant. 

The timeline for disbursement of funds may vary depending on the processing time of applications. 

The implementing authorities for this scheme are usually state governments or designated agencies responsible for welfare in the unorganized sector.
